name: cleargate
description: A bank voice agent that can refund real money. Every tool call goes through AgntID; when it refuses, it says why and what to do next, in Hindi or English, spoken by Amazon Polly. ClearGate attacks it, proposes policy, gates CI and signs the proof.

paragraphs: The agent acts. AgntID decides. The engineer signs.

We built a voice support agent for a bank's failed-payment line. It takes calls in Hindi and English and works as a team: voice → accounts → payments → ops. It can refund real money, so it acts only through AgntID, which decides every tool call it makes. ClearGate is the go-live gate that proves it: it attacks the gated agent beside the same agent with no guardrails, evolves the attacks, proposes the AgntID policy, gates CI and signs a record anyone can verify offline.

Where it stands. Everything is built, and every number here was measured on the local stand-in of AgntID's decisions, labelled "not AgntID" in each record. The AgntID runtime is set up on our machine. No live run has completed yet; scripts/liveall.sh runs them and fills the live table.
